titulo: Ecuador and Panama Use Nuclear Techniques to Research, Restore and Protect their Cultural Heritage

titulo: IAEA Delivers Report to Viet Nam on its Nuclear Power Infrastructure Development
resumo: The IAEA has handed over to Viet Nam the final report of a peer review mission that assessed the country's development of the infrastructure needed for a safe, secure and sustainable nuclear power programme.

titulo: IAEA ZODIAC Week Sets Roadmap to Strengthen Global Pandemic Readiness
resumo: Following a week of intensive discussions, global experts on zoonotic diseases defined the next phase of the IAEA’s Zoonotic Disease Integrated Action (ZODIAC) initiative, which aims to fortify the world’s defences against future disease outbreaks.
